subject: Gradual onboarding & accommodations — Sara Lopez return plan
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@example.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: phased return and workplace accommodations

Hi Markus / Laura,

I hope you both are well. My provider cleared me to return to work on a phased schedule starting the week of Nov 3. I wanted to start the conversation about a short-term accommodation plan to make the transition sustainable — primarily reduced daily hours for 4 weeks, a dedicated ergonomic chair, and the ability to work from home on Wednesdays for the first month.

I've attached the physician note that outlines a 60% schedule for the first two weeks, then 80% the next two weeks. I appreciate any guidance on the formal process or forms HR needs from me. Happy to set up a quick sync.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: physician_note_sara_lopez_2025-10-30.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased return and workplace accommodations

Sara — thanks for the note and congrats on the upcoming return. I've read the physician note. First pass thoughts: 60% -> 80% ramp looks reasonable; we'll need a concrete daily-hour schedule so we can align coverage and meeting handoffs.

Laura — can you advise on the HR formality (FMLA/short-term accommodation) and confirm whether the vendor can provision an ergonomic chair on a 7–10 day lead? Grace, I'd like you to partner on coverage for the first two weeks (you had previously agreed to take on the weekly roadmap sync).

Sara, can you propose the specific hours you prefer (e.g., 10am–4pm with 30m unpaid break) and whether Wednesdays remote is firm? I'll draft a simple return plan after we confirm.

- Markus

--
Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@example.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased return and workplace accommodations

Thanks for looping me in. TL;DR: we can support the proposed phased schedule and the chair. A couple of administrative notes:

- Please complete the short-term accommodation form (link below). We need a signed physician note (we have the PDF you attached), the employee's proposed schedule, and a manager acknowledgment.
- If the leave fall under FMLA/other statutory protections we will record it accordingly; I'll confirm once I review Sara's personnel file.
- Ergonomic chair: our vendor (hr_vendor@peachhr.com) can ship to Sara's home within 7 business days once I approve the request.

Action items:
1) Sara: fill out the accommodation form (I can draft the schedule if easier).
2) Markus: confirm acceptance of the proposed hours so I can mark manager acknowledgment.
3) Grace: coordinate the calendar swaps for standing meetings for the first 2 weeks — we want no more than two meetings >30m per day for Sara during ramp.

Link: https://hr.redwood.com/accommodations/form (internal)

I'll prepare the formal accommodation record and share a Doc with the approved start date and expectations.

Best,
Laura Bennett
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@example.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: phased return and workplace accommodations

Laura / Sara — per earlier, Sara confirmed the following preferred schedule in our 11/3 sync:

Week 1 (Nov 3–7): 10:00–15:00 (5 hours/day, 60% capacity)
Week 2 (Nov 10–14): 10:00–16:00 (6 hours/day, 70% capacity)
Week 3 (Nov 17–21): 09:30–17:00 with a 60–90m lunch (80% capacity)
Week 4 (Nov 24–28): standard hours with reduced meeting load (90–100% ramp)

Wednesdays remote for the first two weeks (Nov 5 and Nov 12) is confirmed. Grace has accepted ownership of the roadmap sync for Weeks 1–2 and will send calendar updates.

I've attached a short draft return plan for HR sign-off — it includes coverage notes and a contact plan for escalations. Laura, can you confirm vendor approval for the chair and whether any legal review is needed for documentation?

Attachment: return_plan_v1.docx

Thanks — marking this as manager acknowledgment pending HR confirmation.

- Markus
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@example.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gradual onboarding & accommodations — Sara Lopez return plan

Thank you everyone — I appreciate the quick coordination and the draft plan looks good to me. Confirming I will complete the accommodation form today and upload the signed physician note to the HR portal.

I also appreciate Grace covering the few syncs — I will share a short handover doc for outstanding items (search ranking rollout, open PRs, and the A/B test schedule) later today.

Sara Lopez
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference
